observations.observation: Bloomberg is the earliest traceable public report found here of Oracle’s force-majeure notice, published Sept. 24 at 12:25Z. It described a potential payment-deferral right if Jupiter missed its 2028 target; it did not report a one-year delay.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: The notice itself and its exact delivery time were not located; Bloomberg attributed the report to people familiar with the matter.

observations.observation: Reuters’ later Sept. 24 coverage added a claim that the program was delayed by a year because of power-securing delays. The claim was attributed to one person familiar with the notice and deal; no official revised schedule or specific Bloom deployment scope was reported.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: The syndicated page shows a 7:00 p.m. EDT update, before cutoff, but the direct Reuters page was not retrieved. Oracle said the project remained on schedule; Blue Owl said commitments were unchanged.

observations.observation: Reuters described financing scrutiny spreading to other proposed data-center financings and reported that SB Energy had delayed its IPO that week. Axios had already publicly listed an SB Energy IPO delay on Sept. 23, before the Jupiter notice was first reported.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: Reuters attributes the financing discussion and IPO timing to sources; the prior Axios item means the IPO delay itself was already public, and the sources do not establish that Jupiter caused it.

observations.observation: A power-supply schedule risk was public before Sept. 24: OilPrice reported on Aug. 14 that the Green Chile pipeline’s expected in-service date had shifted to Feb. 1, 2027 from Aug. 15, 2026.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: OilPrice attributes the date to a regulatory filing; the pipeline date does not by itself establish a revised Jupiter completion date or Bloom delivery schedule.

observations.observation: Before cutoff, FERC had published an environmental assessment for the proposed Green Chile pipeline with comments due Oct. 5. The notice says the assessment is not a decision document, so it did not establish final authorization.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: The assessment’s stated environmental finding was not a final authorization or confirmation of the pipeline’s in-service timing.

observations.observation: On Sept. 17, local coverage reported that the New Mexico Supreme Court denied petitions and lifted procedural stays affecting the air-permit proceeding and water well. It also reported that a new hearing examiner remained necessary.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: The ruling reopened procedural paths but did not grant the air permit or establish a new hearing date.

observations.observation: Oracle’s Sept. 14 statement distinguished the data-center buildings from the proposed microgrid and said construction to that date was on the campus. On Sept. 24, contemporaneous coverage quoted Oracle maintaining the planned schedule and Blue Owl saying financial commitments were unchanged.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: These are issuer and developer positions reported publicly, not independent confirmation of schedule or power readiness; Oracle’s Sept. 14 statement predates the Sept. 17 court action.

gaps: No notice text, underlying force-majeure clause, or exact notice transmission time was located.

The one-year delay is a source-attributed report; no primary sponsor, developer, Oracle, customer, or Bloom disclosure of revised dates, accepted capacity, or affected Bloom delivery scope was located by cutoff.
The reported financing spillover is based on interviews. The SB Energy IPO delay was already publicly mentioned on Sept. 23, and the sources do not demonstrate a causal connection to Jupiter.

The Reuters direct page was not retrieved. The date-only supplied publication metadata and the Reuters-labelled syndication page’s 6:51 p.m. EDT publication / 7:00 p.m. EDT modification are distinct timing evidence.
The precise Green Chile in-service date is reported by OilPrice from a regulatory filing; the official FERC notice retrieved here confirms an open environmental review, not that revised date.
